claims.claim: PS4 Pro packs in twice the GPU power of the standard PS4.
claims.evidence: The witness only reported PlayStation-branded black packaging with the text “WILCOX HARRY”. No console model/version (PS4 vs PS4 Pro) or hardware details were shown.

risks.risk: The photos show only the box/packaging, not the actual console—so the console model, condition, and functionality are unknown.
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the actual console (front and back labels) showing the model/version (e.g., CUH-xxxx) and serial/region, plus a boot-up screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as packaging-only / untested item (worst case: no working console).

risks.risk: Model/version may not be PS4 Pro; could be standard PS4 or another PlayStation variant.
risks.proof: Close-up of the console’s model code on the sticker (CUH-xxxx) and/or the system settings screen showing “PS4 Pro”.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard/unknown PlayStation console (worst case: not Pro).

risks.risk: Storage capacity (e.g., 1TB/500GB) is unknown and affects value.
risks.proof: Photo of the storage info from Settings → System Storage, or a screenshot showing total storage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lowest common storage/unknown capacity.

risks.risk: Condition and completeness are unknown (scratches, dents, missing parts, included accessories).
risks.proof: Photos of the console exterior, all included accessories laid out (controller, cables, headset, stand), and any missing items noted.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown accessories (worst case: minimal/no accessories).

risks.risk: Functional status is unknown (may not power on, may have faulty HDMI/ports, overheating, or broken controller).
risks.proof: Video of powering on to the home screen, plus a quick test showing HDMI output and controller pairing/charging.

risks.risk: Account/region/lock status and potential ban risk are unknown (e.g., console banned, primary account issues).
risks.proof: Photo of the console serial/region label and a brief sign-in/connection test; also confirm whether it was previously used with another account and whether it can be set up normally.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially locked/limited use (worst case: reduced buyer confidence).

proof_requests: Show the actual console (not just the box): front/back photos with the model code (CUH-xxxx) and serial/region label.
Provide a boot-up video reaching the PS home screen (or system menu) to confirm it powers on and works.
Show storage capacity from Settings → System Storage (or a screenshot).
List and photograph all included accessories (controller, cables, headset/stand) and confirm they are present.
Provide controller condition proof (buttons/joystick drift check, charging port photo, and pairing test).
Confirm whether the console is banned/locked and whether it can be set up as a new user (brief sign-in/setup test).
response.reason: The witness report only supports PlayStation-branded packaging text; it does not confirm the console model, condition, or whether it works. Without proof of the actual console and functionality, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
